verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS changelog and announcement tool, so operating it through natural-language commands is a fair question to ask. The only AI evidence is AI-assisted drafting of changelog posts. That is content generation, an adjacent feature, not a way to run the product (create segments, send notifications, configure widgets) by natural-language instruction. No-code setup and the API/webhooks are also not natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
